title: CROSSFILTER BOTH makes the fact table filter a dimension for one calculation
query: MEASURE Sales[Customers Buying] = CALCULATE ( [Customers], CROSSFILTER ( Sales[CustomerKey], Customer[CustomerKey], BOTH ) )

source.quote: the cross-filter direction, which can be BOTH, ONEWAY, NONE
source.supports: the page's example has this shape: Customers is the same on every row, Customers Buying is filtered through Sales

source.quote: If the table has no rows, COUNTROWS returns BLANK , not 0
source.supports: no customer bought a Green product: COUNTROWS of an empty table is BLANK

derivation: Customers: the color does not reach Customer (single direction), 4 on every row. Customers Buying, with both directions: Red (products 1, 2) is Sales rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 with customers 1, 1, 2, 3, 1: 3 distinct. Blue (product 3) is rows 4, 6 with customers 2, 3: 2. Green (product 4) has no sales, so no customer: BLANK. The Green row stays because Customers is 4.
